title: det[w, σ] = ⟨w, ν⟩·det[ν, σ] when span σ = (span{ν})^⊥
statement: Let n ≥ 0, let ν, w ∈ ℝ^{n+1} with |ν| = 1, and let σ = (σ_0, …, σ_{n−1}) be a family in ℝ^{n+1} with span{σ_0, …, σ_{n−1}} = (span{ν})^⊥. For x ∈ ℝ^{n+1} let [x, σ] be the (n+1)×(n+1) real matrix whose column 0 is x and whose column l+1 is σ_l (its entry in row r, column c is the r-th coordinate of the c-th column vector). Then det[w, σ] = ⟨w, ν⟩·det[ν, σ].
lean_statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (ν w : Euclid (n + 1)) (σ : Fin n → Euclid (n + 1)), ‖ν‖ = 1 → Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range σ) = (Submodule.span ℝ {ν})ᗮ → Matrix.det (Matrix.of fun r c : Fin (n + 1) => (Fin.cons w σ : Fin (n + 1) → Euclid (n + 1)) c r) = inner ℝ w ν * Matrix.det (Matrix.of fun r c : Fin (n + 1) => (Fin.cons ν σ : Fin (n + 1) → Euclid (n + 1)) c r)
